ssh_mux.description: Per-endpoint OpenSSH multiplexing. true uses the shared ControlMaster; false forces an independent connection. When omitted, REMOTE_DEV_SSH_MUX is the process default. Hour-scale streams use Endpoint.for_long_stream, which sets ssh_mux=false.

keepalive.description: Add ServerAliveInterval/CountMax. Mechanism flag, orthogonal to mux. Hour-scale streams use Endpoint.for_long_stream rather than this flag alone.
